items.source: Returns the self link for the given entity instance. Only call this with an actual entity instance. Otherwise, prefer createSelfLinkFor(Class, Object).
items.translation: 返回给定实体实例的自链接。仅针对实际的实体实例调用此方法；否则，请优先使用createSelfLinkFor(Class, Object)。

items.source: Component to create self links for entity instances.
items.translation: 用于为实体实例创建自链接的组件。

items.source: Returns the self link for the entity of the given type and the given reference.
items.translation: 返回给定类型和引用的实体的自链接。

items.source: Returns the self link for the given entity instance.
items.translation: 返回给定实体实例的自链接。

items.source:
Returns the self link for the entity of the given type and the given reference. The latter can be an instance of
the former, an identifier value of the former or anything that can be converted into an identifier in the first
place.
items.translation: 返回给定类型和引用的实体的自链接。后者可以是前者的实例、前者的标识符值，或任何可转换为标识符的内容。
